entities.name: The Prodigal Sorcerer
entities.description: The sixth Magic novel, published October 1995 by HarperPrism and written by Mark Sumner.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Human leader who plans to bring harmony to the Valley of Tamingazin; assassinated right after being declared king and bey.

entities.name: Talli
entities.description: Tagard's daughter, who teams up with Lisolo and defeats Karelon.

entities.name: Karelon
entities.description: Tagard's general, secretly part of the conspiracy to kill him, who starts a xenophobic war.

entities.name: Alligarius Timni
entities.description: Wizard of the Institute of Arcane Study who helps take Berimish, is lured into drugs, steals the Magewall Hub, then repents.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: Wizards' institute on the mountain at the center of the valley.

entities.name: Valley of Tamingazin
entities.description: Valley where Viashino, Garan and humans warred.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: Largest Viashino city and the last in the valley to fall.

entities.name: Lisolo
entities.description: Former city bey of Berimish who sits on the council and allies with Talli.

entities.name: Rael Gar
entities.description: Garan leader killed during the fighting, who had usurped Recin's mother's leadership.

entities.name: Recin
entities.description: Garan elf boy who guides Talli and is falsely accused of the assassination.

entities.name: Janin
entities.description: Recin's mother.

entities.name: Getin
entities.description: Recin's aunt.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Suderbod ambassador who befriends Timni and supplies him with drugs.

entities.name: Kitrin
entities.description: Young wizard of the Institute sent with Recin to find Timni.

entities.name: Suderbod
entities.description: Nation that invades Tamingazin with En'Jaga.

entities.name: Magewall
entities.description: Barrier of the valley whose Hub Timni steals and later restores.

entities.name: En'Jaga
entities.description: Creatures used in the Suder army's attack.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: One of the three races of the valley.

entities.name: Garan
entities.description: Elven race of the valley.

entities.name: Mark Sumner
entities.description: Author of the novel.

events.summary: Tagard, Talli and Karelon climb to the Institute to seek a wizard's aid, and Tagard convinces Alligarius Timni to join him.
events.quote: Tagard now convinces Alligarius Timni to accompany him to defeat Berimish

events.summary: Timni uses magic to take Berimish without bloodshed; Lisolo is invited onto the council.
events.quote: uses magic to have the army sneak into the castle and take the city without bloodshed

events.summary: Talli hires Recin as guide and warms to him and Viashino culture.
events.quote: Talli recruits the Garan Elf Recin to be her guide around Berimish.

events.summary: Ursal Daleel befriends the restless Timni and hooks him on drugs from Suderbod.
events.quote: he deviously hooks Timni up with drugs produced in Suderbod

events.summary: Tagard is assassinated with a Viashino crossbow; Karelon takes power and accuses Recin.
events.quote: Tagard Tarngold is assassinated with a Viashino crossbow immediately after being declared king and bey

events.summary: Karelon's conspiracy is revealed and she wages war on the Viashino; Talli and Lisolo defeat her; Rael Gar is killed.
events.quote: Talli teams up with Lisolo, despite her prejudice towards the viashino, and eventually manages to defeat Karelon.

events.summary: Timni steals the Magewall Hub and defects to Suderbod; Talli sends Kitrin and Recin, who are captured but escape with Timni's help.
events.quote: Talli learns that Timni has stolen the Magewall Hub and has defected to the nation of Suderbod.

events.summary: The Suder army attacks with En'Jaga; just before a rout, Timni restores the Magewall and stops the armies.
events.quote: the returned Timni manages to restore the Magewall and the advancing armies are stopped
